title: RoomStatus
description: Where a room's job is, as the room status endpoint returns it. The app shows only what this says: one stage, a machine-readable reason when it failed, how the room was measured, and for each design item whether a fit check ran.

confidence_level.description: The room twin's confidence level, once the room is read. estimated: sizes say measure to confirm and no item carries a fit claim.

design_request_id.description: The latest design request for the room, once one is made.

awaiting_brief.description: True when the room is read and no design request has been made yet: designing starts as soon as the app sends one.

items.description: Every item of every design, once designs exist; empty before.

status.description: The room job alone (reading), for builds made before `stage`. Read `stage`.

stages.description: The pipeline rows behind `stage`, room rows first, then the latest design request's.

RoomStage.description: uploaded: the capture is registered and the job is queued. reading: measuring the room and listing what is in it. designing: choosing products and placing them. rendering: drawing the designs on the photos. ready: three designs with their pictures. failed: see failure.

RoomFailureReason.description: Why the job stopped. upload_incomplete: a file of the capture is not in storage. photo_too_small: a photo is below the minimum the render needs. timed_out: a stage ran past its limit and its retry. internal: an error on our side; trying again may work.

retryable.description: True when asking again (the same room or design request) may succeed; false when the capture itself must change.

fit_checked.description: True when the verifier checked this item's fit against measured (ar_measured or taped) sizes. False on an estimated room, where items are placed at nominal sizes and no fit is claimed.

detail.description: The failure reason code when the row failed.
